name: Legendary Sword Core (Celestial Plasma Detail)
description: Mythic 3D showcase of the crystalline tamahagane sword core. A luminous faceted meteorite crystal core pulsating with intense crimson and gold celestial plasma energy, hovering above a dark stone forge anvil with swirling heat embers.
